resources.string: Add an access card and keep its identity here. Compatibility depends on the device and access reader.
An active card will be stopped before it is removed.
This is an NFC identity, not a copy of encrypted card contents.
A local wallet for NFC access-card identities. No account or network access is required. Identity emulation does not reproduce encrypted sectors or guarantee access-reader acceptance.
No UID length has been RF-verified on this device yet.
Choose a card, then tap Use this card.
Another NFC identity is in use
The identity is applied. Stop this card before using payment cards. Access-reader acceptance is separate.
You can keep cards here. This device or NFC module is not qualified for emulation.
Turn on NFC to read or use a card.
NFC could not be restored. Turn NFC off and on before trying again.
The current hardware state could not be confirmed. Try refreshing or restart NFC.
Hold the card against the NFC area on the back of your phone. Keep it still until it is read.
Give it a name and a look. Saving does not activate it.
Reading a new card requires leaving emulation mode. The previous card will stay stopped after reading.
The card could not be read. Keep it close and try again.
This card does not provide a supported NFC-A identity.
This card is already in your wallet.
The wallet could not be read or saved. Existing data has been preserved.
The operation could not be completed. Please try again.
The card could not be applied. Check the current NFC status.
The card could not be stopped safely. Restart NFC and try again.
This identity or UID length is not enabled for emulation on this device.
The Quick Settings request was not completed. You can add AccessCard from the panel editor.
The card moved away too soon. Hold it close and try again.
NFC is busy. Finish reading or wait for the current operation, then try again.
The NFC service is unavailable. Reopen NFC and try again.
The original NFC settings could not be read. No new card was activated.
The NFC controller rejected these settings. The card was not activated.
NFC settings did not match after writing. Check the active card before retrying.
The NFC controller did not respond in time. Turn NFC off and on before retrying.
NFC recovery data is unavailable. NFC remains paused. Collect diagnostics before retrying.
NFC listening could not restart. Turn NFC off and on to restore normal operation.

Off by default. Records only while enabled: up to 512 events (16 KiB), from the last 24 hours. Turning this off deletes the private diagnostic cache. Card names, identifiers and backup passwords are never recorded.
Exported files are saved where you choose. Turning off recording clears only the private cache; it does not delete files you exported.

Use and stop cards explicitly. Restarting NFC or the phone does not automatically activate a saved card. Stop emulation before paying. Screen-off and locked-device behavior require device testing; no screen-off support is promised.
The operation could not be completed. Check storage and try again; no success has been reported.
User-reported observations, not device certification. Keeps the latest 20 records per card. These records never change hardware qualification.
